summary: The clips of “desperta” from the `tigregotico-desperta-ca` test set, placed between seconds of Catalan speech, followed by 7 hours of read speech, music, household and outdoor sounds and speech in other languages with no wake word. A detector streams every recording and is scored on the wake words it caught and on how often per hour it woke with no wake word.
notes: Built by scripts/publish_ww_stream_bench.py from `tigregotico-desperta-ca` at TigreGotico/synthetic-wakeword-desperta@a03e094f (390 of 390 clips with the phrase) and the negatives of `ca-ES`. The negatives hold 4 h of read speech, 1 h of music, 1 h of household and outdoor sounds, 1 h of speech in other languages: 7 hours in all.
